name: genpark-personal-agent-pulmonary-stress-index-ventilator-titration-skill
description: Calculates and stratifies mechanical ventilation Stress Index (Paw = a * t^b + c) to distinguish alveolar recruitment (b < 0.95), linear compliance (0.95-1.05), and tidal overdistension (b > 1.05).
author: AlphaPark
